scope_note: Agent evidence review 2026-10-19 inspected fresh main, recent changes, repository instructions, active tasks/claims, weakest coverage, schemas, canonical/exported profiles and media, exporter, validation scripts, test assertions and CI contract before editing. Five supplemental artifact/evaluator self-tests passed. All 68 local commands passed: 62 package validators, type check, 294 application tests, build, 103 Python tests, artifact verification and diff check. Worktree isolation and fresh-verification skills guided branch and integration gates. Operational task claim excluded from commits and released after merge; unrelated work preserved. No actual training, inference or production deployment. Remaining gaps: matched Cannabis root-ball/canopy controls, measured spatial root data, licensed progression imagery and diagnostic video.
